title: Open Challenge: Beat This Strategy. 4 Yrs of BT, 96.31% Win Rate. Video Attached
author: Classic_Goal5420
selftext:
I've been working on this strategy based on support resistance+Price Action for quite a while and the Deep Backtesting results are attached.

Instead of asking whether it's good, I'm throwing out a challenge.

**Can anyone here beat these metrics with their own strategy?**

Not looking for screenshots of one lucky week. Show a robust backtest with comparable history, and similar trade count.

If you think my strategy is flawed, even better. Tell me where you'd attack it. I'd rather have it destroyed here than by the market later.
